problems_fixed.what: Stored answer for dandelion population estimate was wrong (2000). 8 quadrats of 0.5 m^2, mean 5, scale = 400/0.5 = 800, so population = 5*800 = 4000. The problem's own misconception text already stated 4,000. Corrected solutions 2000 -> 4000.

misconceptions_repaired: Added required expect key to every misconception (previously absent, which the validator rejects). Derived each expect by committing the actual error: percentage-change wrong_denominator expects (divide by new), population wrong_area expects (skip quadrat-area division), forgot_step expects (multiply raw total instead of mean), forgot_divide expects (leave sum un-divided). All expects verified to sit outside each problem's accept window. Rewrote gold[0]'s two misconception messages, removing a stray em dash and the messy self-correcting 'Wait, re-check' text; set the wrong_area expect to 2000 (the old wrong answer, now a genuine student trap).
em_dashes_removed: Replaced em dashes in preserved fields with colons: exam_context.frequency ('Medium — ...' -> 'Medium: ...') and six worked_examples step labels ('Step 1 — ...' -> 'Step 1: ...'). Required by the no-em-dash hard rule and the validator.
figures_note: No electricity/circuit content and no chart problems in this bank (all pure mean/percentage-change/quadrat calculation). No problem text claims a graph or figure, so no figures required.
propagation: Both rows PATCHed with identical practice_data; refetched and confirmed byte-identical to each other and to the shard.
opener_concept: Pocket-money sharing = mean; an £8/hour wage getting a £2 rise = percentage change on the ORIGINAL. Reused from the topic-identical AQA sibling conversion (non-bank puzzle, board-neutral).
tier_ladder: Ladder matches the science spec: Bronze = single calculation with values given (mean or straight % change); Silver = one scale-up (population from quadrats) or a % change rounded to a stated d.p.; Gold = multi-step chaining (mean-then-scale-then-% change). Kept existing tier sizes 6/4/3; no reordering.
board_neutrality: Shared row serves science-ocr-b + separate-sciences-ocr-b. No board named, no equation-sheet claim anywhere. All three formulae are recall-based data skills.
walks: Every bank problem given full guided_steps with a phase:'substitute' completion boundary that pre-works the set-up (state equation / find the mean) and leaves the finishing arithmetic plus a check to the student (>=2 live boxes each). Added opener + three teach walks (leaf-length mean / buttercup population / frog % change) + tier_guides adapted to this bank. Every box value independently fresh-solved and confirmed to land on the stored solutions; final say-steps state the unit (per quadrat, %, plants).
notes: method_card slimmed to a 4-step reference within budget. topic_links, exam_context (bar the em dash), worked_examples (bar label em dashes), related_videos preserved. Live validator PASS on canonical row.
